# Composer commands

## Common questions

- What `@` commands run immediately without sending a prompt?
- How do I reset Help & Guidance?

## What commands are

Composer **commands** run app actions when selected from the `@` palette. They are **not** sent to the language model.

## Available commands

### Reset Help & Guidance

Palette id: `reset_help_guidance`. Run setup tour on next launch; turn off Model Manager hints

Requires confirmation before running.

## Also called

palette commands, app commands, immediate actions
